name: ReStep
summary: Capture disassembly photos and voice notes, then follow the steps in reverse.
description: ReStep records repair or disassembly photos and spoken notes on Rokid RG-glasses, syncs them to a phone, and presents the steps in reverse order for reassembly. Offline Russian and English voice commands and temple taps control capture. This preview pairs glasses 0.18 with Android companion 0.1; an iPhone companion is available separately upstream. The glasses flow was exercised on RG-glasses/Android 12, but Android Bluetooth pairing and direct Wi-Fi transfer still need physical-phone validation. The Android companion requires Android 10 or later.
author: oldmelnick-afk

releases.notes:
Hands-free capture: say Take photo, dictate the step, then Send.

Install the glasses APK on RG-glasses; the Android APK on an Android 10+ PHONE; re-sign the iPhone IPA with Sideloadly/AltStore. Standard iPhone build, no Auto Wi-Fi.

Android phone build/lint and two focused emulator checks passed; physical Android BLE/Wi-Fi transfer is not yet verified. See README for controls, permissions and testing limits.

Tags: Rokid, smart glasses, hands-free, repair, Android, iOS.
